name: Radiowave Journey
descriptionText: Not content with repeatedly listening to the same albums' melodies, and unwilling to stay stuck in the same Hollow scenery. Even among the travelers who wander the Hollows, there are those romantic adventurers, poets of sorts, who go too far. "Radiowave Journey" is designed specifically for these romantic fools. Its additional radio module can convert Etheric frequencies into musical melodies, playing different styles of music depending on the type of Hollow you're in.
